translations.web: Then I said, ‘Behold, I have come (in the scroll of the book it is written of me) to do your will, O God.’ ”
translations.bsb: Then I said, ‘Here I am, it is written about Me in the scroll: I have come to do Your will, O God.’”
translations.kjv: Then said I, Lo, I come (in the volume of the book it is written of me,) to do thy will, O God.
translations.asv: Then said I, Lo, I am come (In the roll of the book it is written of me) To do thy will, O God.
